second_independent_pass.requested_for: high-visibility group — the error sentence and the six failure-class labels
second_independent_pass.method: Both passes were done by this auditor: pass 1 key-by-key before reading the translator's notes, pass 2 re-deriving each error key from the context sidecar alone (register, length, distinguishability) and re-reading the values with fresh eyes.
second_independent_pass.pass2_results: Unchanged verdict. Specifically re-examined and cleared: (a) अस्वीकृत vs गेट विफल stay distinguishable (permission refusal vs policy gate); (b) अज्ञात टूल vs अमान्य आर्ग्युमेंट stay distinguishable; (c) singular 'आर्ग्युमेंट' does not lose the class meaning in Hindi label register — accepted, not a finding; (d) the busy sentence promises no success and no duration; (e) the one label that remains a concern is F1 (ऑडियो दर सीमा reads as the constraint noun, the only non-adjectival label of the six).

findings.problem: Label register inconsistency inside the six-class set: the other five read as a state of the call (अस्वीकृत, गेट विफल, अज्ञात टूल, अमान्य आर्ग्युमेंट, डुप्लिकेट id), while this one is a bare noun compound meaning 'audio rate limit' — the constraint, not the failure. `दर सीमा` is the right term (attested: 'दर सीमा लगी है', 'दर-सीमाएँ'), so the fix is to carry the 'limited' state, not to replace the term.
findings.caveat: दर-सीमित is a coinage (participle of the attested दर सीमा); if the programme rejects coinages, the hyphenated constraint label ऑडियो दर-सीमा at least matches the shipped usage_reset morphology, but it still reads as the constraint rather than the state.

findings.current: शुल्क की पुष्टि जाँची जा रही है।
findings.problem: Slightly circular: it says the *confirmation* is being checked (पुष्टि जाँची जा रही है), i.e. verifying a confirmation, where the state is that confirmation itself is in progress. Also one word longer than the English's three-word hint (the translator's note acknowledges four words).
findings.suggested: शुल्क की पुष्टि की जा रही है।

verdict_basis: No BLOCKER and no MAJOR remain: mechanical integrity is clean (12/12 keys, placeholder and select parity, non-vacuous negative controls), no promise, permission or error fact is altered, terminology follows the shipped catalogue and glossary, register follows the hi style guide. The single MINOR is a label-register consistency point, actionable in the same remediation wave without changing meaning.
considered_and_accepted: error_class.invalid_arguments — singular 'अमान्य आर्ग्युमेंट' for English's plural: Hindi label register uses the singular for a class of failure and the shipped catalogue has only singular आर्ग्युमेंट attested. Accepted as-is.

error_class.duplicate_id — lowercase Latin 'id': the shipped hi catalogue uses BOTH 'id' (14 values, e.g. 'शीर्षक या id से खोजें', 'एसेट की id') and 'ID' (25 values); no rule violated, source casing mirrored. Accepted as-is.
settlement.pending — 'प्रोवाइडर के रिपोर्ट करने पर': grammatically sound (के … करने पर) and रिपोर्ट/दिखेगा are both attested in the shipped catalogue. Accepted as-is.

cancel.running — future 'जनरेशन जारी रहेगा' where English has present 'continues': same fact, and it reproduces the shipped sound.stop.warning sentence byte-for-byte after the first sentence. Accepted as-is.
